precondition: The agent asks for the customer's full name or account ID and clicks Pull up Account to load their record. This is a data-fetch mechanic shared by the opening step of most flows; the Phase 1 corpus does not encode it as a testable rule because no eligibility or amount depends on it -- it is not gated, it is prerequisite plumbing. (subcluster: account_access)
postcondition: No policy-governed consequence follows from this step alone; observed across 3 distinct subflows (recover_password, recover_username, reset_2fa).
